verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows scattered fragments — contact/tag creation via API (mailchimp-docs-4), a 'Predictive Segmentation' pricing line item (mailchimp-docs-10), and webhook-based data sync (mailchimp-docs-19) — but no documentation of how segments are actually built from combined profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, nor confirmation that they update live as data changes. Missing for 10: dedicated segmentation/segment-builder docs, explicit behavioral-event triggers feeding segments, and evidence/testimony that segments refresh dynamically rather than as static snapshots.
